name: kalpana-batch
description: Generate ad creatives, product images and banners in bulk from a spreadsheet or product list: one finished image or video per row, for every product or campaign.

interface.longDescription: Kalpana Batch generates ad creatives, product images and banners in bulk from a spreadsheet or product list: one finished image or video per row, from your Kalpana designs. Pick a design, add your data, check every row and see the cost, then render once you approve and download the finished files. One connection covers one workspace, within your role there.
defaultPrompt: Show my latest Kalpana batches and their status.
Find a Kalpana template for my next campaign.
Fill the summer banner for these three products and show me a preview.

positive.description: Browse the workspace's templates and one template's inputs. Passes when the inputs listed match the template. Setup: sign in with the reviewer account and choose the OpenAI Review workspace, which holds the Diwali Sale Banner and Product Story templates, the Review Products image collection and a three-row draft batch.
positive.prompt: Show me the templates in my Kalpana workspace and what the Diwali Sale Banner needs filled in.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace's templates with their names and sizes, then names the Diwali Sale Banner's inputs (Headline, Price, Product photo, Tag, CTA and Logo) with their types. Nothing is created and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Check rows against a template without creating anything. Passes when both rows are reported valid and no batch exists afterwards. Setup: sign in with the reviewer account and choose the OpenAI Review workspace, which holds the Diwali Sale Banner and Product Story templates, the Review Products image collection and a three-row draft batch.
positive.prompt: Fill the Diwali Sale Banner for Burgundy Tote at ₹2,499 and Cream Kettle at ₹1,499, using their photos from the Review Products collection. Check the rows but don't create anything yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the template and the two photos, builds two rows keyed by layer name, and reports that both rows are valid (or what to fix). No batch is created.

positive.description: Create a draft batch and report its exact cost without rendering. Passes when one draft batch exists and run_batch was not called. Setup: sign in with the reviewer account and choose the OpenAI Review workspace, which holds the Diwali Sale Banner and Product Story templates, the Review Products image collection and a three-row draft batch.
positive.prompt: Create a draft batch of the Diwali Sale Banner for Table Lamp at ₹1,299 with table-lamp.png, and tell me what rendering it would cost. Don't render it.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation before creating, then creates a draft batch with one job and states the exact credit cost returned by create_batch. It does not call run_batch.

positive.description: Render a draft only after the user approves the stated cost, then return the images. Passes when the cost is stated before run_batch and download links are returned. Setup: sign in with the reviewer account and choose the OpenAI Review workspace, which holds the Diwali Sale Banner and Product Story templates, the Review Products image collection and a three-row draft batch.
positive.prompt: Render my latest draft batch and give me the images. Tell me the cost first.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the draft, states its exact credit cost and waits for an explicit yes. After the yes it runs the batch, follows its progress and returns a download link for each finished image.

positive.description: Edit one job in a draft batch. Passes when only the Cream Kettle job's Price changes and nothing renders. Setup: sign in with the reviewer account and choose the OpenAI Review workspace, which holds the Diwali Sale Banner and Product Story templates, the Review Products image collection and a three-row draft batch.
positive.prompt: In my latest draft batch, change the Cream Kettle price to ₹1,349.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Cream Kettle job, confirms the change, updates only its Price, and shows the new value. Nothing is rendered.

negative.description: General copywriting with no template, batch or image work. Expected: answered without calling any Kalpana Batch tool.
negative.prompt: Write three taglines for a coffee brand.

negative.description: Kalpana fills templates; it does not generate new images with an AI model. Expected: no Kalpana Batch tool is called and the plugin is not said to have made the photo.
negative.prompt: Generate a photo of a model carrying a burgundy tote bag on a beach.

negative.description: Posting or scheduling on a social network is outside the plugin. Expected: no Kalpana Batch tool is called and nothing is said to have been posted.
negative.prompt: Schedule an Instagram post for tomorrow at 9am saying our Diwali sale has started.

publication.release_notes: First release of Kalpana Batch for ChatGPT. Find your Kalpana templates, turn a list or spreadsheet into checked rows, create a draft batch, render it once you approve, and fetch the finished images and videos.
